thread:
mira: Deploy completed for feature/quiet-window at 19:02 UTC. Canary is on ~3% traffic. I'm starting the 10m smoke/watch window now — please run the lightweight checklist and post any red flags here. Quick commands: `./ops/smoke/quick_smoke.sh` or `curl -s https://status.internal/ready | jq .`. tagging @sre-oncall @ryan for infra checks.

deploy-bot: Canary targets: service=inference-a, inference-b; image=redwood/inference:release-2026-03-17. Watchers notified and health probes enabled.

ryan: on it — kicking off `quick_smoke.sh` against the canary pool (pinned). will paste results.

elaine: ran the UI e2e smoke (light). sessions ok, auth flows returned 200 across 200 requests. no obvious errors in UI logs.

aj: pulled prometheus windows (last 10m). p50 stable, p95 increased ~20ms for 512-token sequences only. within alert thresholds for now. will continue sampling.

sre-oncall: checked traces & error budgets. no new error spike. small RC count bump on node-7 but no increased 5xx. investigating in parallel.

mira: thanks. quick Q: if p95 stays >200ms for 3 consecutive minutes do we trigger rollback? aj can you confirm you're ready to execute rollback script if we hit that?

aj: yep — rollback script staged: `./ops/deploy/rollback.sh --target canary`. I'll trigger after 2 mins sustained regression (or on explicit thumbs-up here).

ryan: validated KV-cache warmup numbers — hit-rate ~78% after initial warmup traffic, expected to stabilize as more requests hit.

elaine: running the promotional prompt sweep now (end-to-end responses). will paste any weird outputs.

elaine: promo sweep done. found one odd hallucination in template-A at prompt idx 42 — not reproducing under load. filing tiny bug #4124. not blocking rollout.

mira: good catch. timeline: target full rollout at +30m if no regressions. leaving the thread open for the watchwindow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Auto-scaling note: Canary scaled 3% -> 13% at +30m per policy (auto-burst).

aj: saw the bump. re-running latency checks for the new traffic level. preliminary: p95 drift still ~+20ms, no error spike.

sre-oncall: if anything looks bad ping #incidents and tag me. otherwise I'll handle on-call rotation at +45m.

ryan: infra side LGTM. post-rollout todo: update release-notes/quiet-window and bump runbook version to 1.08.

mira: summary for this thread before I close: canary progressed per policy, no blocking errors, p95 +20ms on long sequences, KV warmup ~78%, one non-blocking hallucination logged (#4124). full rollout contingent on no regressions in next 15m. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
